summary: Frontend-only check of the Home colour swap at exactly 1920x800 and 390x844, using read-only browser route fixtures. Computed styles confirm the swap. JEE Main card: royal-blue surface (#06112E→#18357A), platinum CTA (#FBFCFF→#CAD5E5) with ink #122952, no ruby tokens left. Home All India banner: ruby/onyx surface (#1A070A/#0D0C10/#24090E), border #984755, ruby CTA #B6112A with ink #FFF7F8, no old royal-blue #0B2D80. BITSAT is still amber (#FFC15B, ink #281806) and COMEDK is still teal (#04181A, CTA ink #063733). Lossless PNG pixel contrast was measured for every visible text run in the JEE card and the banner: settled scroll, visible bboxes below the sticky header, CSS-to-image scaling (1.0), foreground hidden while sampling. States covered: glare off, forced glare at 15 offsets from -55% to +55%, card hover, CTA/nav/primary/hub hover plus glare. Every target meets its threshold (small text 4.5:1, large bold 3:1). Lowest values: mobile banner 'Created by' 4.52 (p1 5.24) at forced glare -25%; banner 'Explore the series' hover 5.05; banner facts 5.13; JEE 'My results' 5.78; JEE CTA 10.88. The only flagged item is '100% AI' on the rotated ribbon. That is a measurement artifact: the axis-aligned bbox of rotated text samples the banner behind the ribbon. Computed on the ribbon itself, dark #3A0B17 ink on the #FFF7F8→#E8CBD1 gradient is about 11:1. Regressions all pass: no horizontal overflow, all 13 Home links target the correct routes, the series explainer modal opens and closes with Escape, Pause/Play shine pauses and resumes all 3 cards, and reduced motion hides the ::before glare on all cards and the banner. Styling stays scoped to Home: the guest landing banner still uses the global #160B10 with CTA #D91222 and is not inside .exam-home, and the Series hub has no .exam-home. 0 mutation requests were attempted.

issues: Not a failure: 'Created by' (series-astra-identity-banner) drops to 4.52:1 at the forced full-opacity glare peak (-25%), only just above 4.5. Optional: nudge #DED0D5 slightly lighter or lower the banner glare's white stop if you want more margin.

critical_code_review_comments: The swap is done through tokens in vibrant-ui.css lines 218-288. JEE now inherits the base .exam-home .bold-exam-card tokens (royal blue). No CSS loaded later (pyq.css) overrides these rules.
ExamHub.js also uses the .exam-home class, but it renders no .bold-exam-card or .flagship-banner, so the scoped rules do not leak there.
Line 213 (.bold-exam-card.exam-tone-jee-main background #1C0E13) is now dead on Home because the .exam-home rule overrides it. Harmless.
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only browser route fixtures only; no auth sessions, DB writes or AI calls.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' because the preview never reaches networkidle. ui_swap_contrast152.py is a generic text-node pixel sampler: give it any container via data-qa-scope. The rotated '100% AI' ribbon always reads as a false failure (bbox artifact), so check it analytically. No app code was changed.
